judgments.reason: The paper title and abstract describe the analysis of long-term invasive recordings and HFOs, which are the core content of the Zurich iEEG HFO Dataset.
judgments.paper_title: Resection of high frequency oscillations predicts seizure outcome in the individual patient

judgments.reason: The paper describes MNE-BIDS, a software tool and specification for organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format, which was used to process this dataset.
judgments.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
judgments.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software

judgments.reason: The paper introduces iEEG-BIDS, a specification for organizing and sharing iEEG data, which is a technical standard or method, not the paper that introduced or described the specific dataset.
judgments.paper_title: iEEG-BIDS, extending the Brain Imaging Data Structure specification to human intracranial electrophysiology
